"""KinDER i00 episode driver. All moves are logged and issued through rcb_client."""
import sys, json, pathlib
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()

def observe(tag, depth=False):
    res = r.get_obs(cameras=['robot_base','robot_wrist'], include_depth=depth, video='none')
    for name, frame in res.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f'{tag}_{name}.png')
    for name, arr in res.depth.items():
        np.save(OUT / f'{tag}_{name}_depth.npy', arr[-1])
    (OUT / f'{tag}_meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
    return res

def move(rows, tag, cameras=['robot_base'], depth=False):
    rows = np.asarray(rows, dtype=float).reshape(-1, 11)
    assert np.all(np.isfinite(rows))
    res = r.submit('delta', rows, cameras=cameras, video='none', include_depth=depth, note=tag)
    with (OUT / 'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({'tag':tag,'rows':rows.tolist(),'meta':res.meta})+'\n')
    for name, frame in res.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f'{tag}_{name}.png')
    for name, arr in res.depth.items():
        np.save(OUT / f'{tag}_{name}_depth.npy', arr[-1])
    print(tag, json.dumps(res.meta), flush=True)
    return res

if __name__ == '__main__':
    res = observe('initial', depth=True)
    print(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))

import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

AXES=np.array([[0,0,-1],[0,1,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0],[0,0,-1],[0,1,0],[0,0,-1]],float)
PIVOTS=np.array([[.1199,0,.1512],[.1199,-.0054,.2796],[.1199,-.0118,.49],[.1199,-.0181,.7004],[.1199,-.0245,.9088],[.1199,-.0247,1.0147],[.1199,-.0249,1.1207]],float)
EE=np.array([.1199,-.0249,1.3022])
CAM=np.array([.1199,.0315,1.2091])
CAM_F=np.array([0,0,1.])
CAM_U=np.array([0,1.,0])
CAM_R=np.array([-1.,0,0])

def tf(q):
    R=np.eye(3); t=np.zeros(3)
    for ax,p,a in zip(AXES,PIVOTS,q):
        Q=Rotation.from_rotvec(ax*a).as_matrix()
        v=p-Q@p
        t=R@v+t; R=R@Q
    return R,t

def frame(q):
    R,t=tf(q)
    return {'ee': R@EE+t,'cam':R@CAM+t,'f':R@CAM_F,'u':R@CAM_U,'r':R@CAM_R}

if __name__=='__main__':
 q=np.array([0,-.35,-np.pi,-2.5,0,-.87,np.pi/2])
 print(frame(q))
PY

def ik(target, q0, down=True, weight_ori=0.15, weight_reg=0.005):
    target=np.asarray(target,float); q0=np.asarray(q0,float)
    lo=np.array([-20,-2.4,-20,-2.65,-20,-2.22,-20]); hi=-lo
    def fun(q):
        p=frame(q)
        a=[*(p['ee']-target)]
        if down: a.extend(weight_ori*(p['f']-np.array([0,0,-1.])))
        a.extend(weight_reg*(q-q0))
        return a
    res=least_squares(fun,np.clip(q0,lo+1e-3,hi-1e-3),bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=300)
    return res.x,res.cost,frame(res.x)

def move_to_ee(target_world, tag, down=True, max_joint_delta=.10, cameras=['robot_wrist'], depth=True):
    from kin import ik
    now=np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'],float)
    base=now[:3]; q0=now[3:10]
    assert abs(base[2])<1e-3, 'IK helper assumes zero base yaw'
    q,cost,pose=ik(np.asarray(target_world)-np.array([base[0],base[1],0]),q0,down)
    if cost>.001: raise RuntimeError(f'IK failed: {cost}')
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(q-q0))/max_joint_delta)))
    A=np.zeros((n,11)); A[:,3:10]=(q-q0)/n
    print('IK target',target_world,'q',q,'predicted EE',pose['ee']+np.array([base[0],base[1],0]),'rows',n,flush=True)
    return move(A,tag,cameras=cameras,depth=depth)
PY
